papers.title: Influence of Post-Processing Temperatures on Microstructure and Hardness of PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effects of post-build heat treatments—such as annealing, quenching, and aging—on the microstructure and hardness of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (PBF-LB) Ti-6Al-4V. Specimens were subjected to annealing (950 °C, 1010 °C) or solution treatment/quenching (950 °C, 1010 °C), followed by aging (350–550 °C). Microstructural evolution was analyzed using optical microscopy (OM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), X-ray diffraction (XRD), electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), and Vickers hardness testing. Results showed that the as-built sample exhibited high hardness (365.2 HV0.1) due to fine α′ martensite. Sub-β-transus annealing at 950 °C decomposed α′ into equilibrium α + 1.25% β (329 HV0.1), while super-β-transus annealing at 1010 °C formed coarse lamellar structures of α + 1.5% β, yielding the lowest hardness (319 HV0.1). Quenching from 1010 °C produced dominant α′ martensite with high hardness (371.6 HV0.1). Notably, aging samples quenched from 950 °C increased hardness, peaking at 382.6 HV0.1 at 450 °C due to precipitation, before decreasing to 364.4 HV0.1 at 550 °C due to coarsening. These findings demonstrate that optimizing heat treatment temperatures is critical for controlling phase transformations and tailoring mechanical properties in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了热处理工艺对PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V显微硬度和微观结构的影响，属于后处理控制方向的基本实验数据。
llm.why_not_core: The paper reports only hardness (Vickers) as mechanical performance, lacking fatigue or tensile tests that are central to the post-processing control focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究退火、淬火和时效等后处理温度对PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V显微组织和硬度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对PBF-LB成形的Ti-6Al-4V样品进行不同温度的热处理，并用OM、SEM、XRD、EBSD和维氏硬度表征。
summary_zh.result: 950°C淬火后450°C时效获得最高硬度382.6 HV0.1，而1010°C退火获得最低硬度319 HV0.1。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微观察和硬度测试验证了不同热处理对组织和硬度的调控效果。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates how post-build heat treatment temperatures (annealing, quenching, aging) affect the microstructure and hardness of laser powder bed fusion (PBF-LB) Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: PBF-LB Ti-6Al-4V specimens were subjected to annealing, solution treatment/quenching, and aging at various temperatures, and characterized using OM, SEM, XRD, EBSD, and Vickers hardness testing.
summary_en.result: Quenching from 950°C followed by aging at 450°C yielded the highest hardness (382.6 HV0.1), while annealing above β-transus at 1010°C produced the lowest hardness (319 HV0.1) due to coarse lamellar α+β structure.
summary_en.validation: The microstructural evolution and hardness variations were experimentally validated through comprehensive microscopy and hardness measurements.
